verdict.rationale: Caveman is a cloud and proxy platform that routes user data to models, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows any training opt-out, no-training guarantee, or data-usage policy. The guardrail rules that mask or block content from reaching a model (caveman-docs-18) are an adjacent data-loss-prevention control, not a guarantee against training use, so they earn no credit.
